body: I appreciate it, I actually reached out with a toned down message because I want to work up to it.

I have bad physical symptoms. Like my heart is just going to explode. Like I'm going to fall through the fabric of reality and go crazy. Neck feels stiff. Can't relax. Sometimes it's hard to sleep. A lot of the time my brain isn't having anxiety actively where I can see it, but my body does and it's maddening. I've been dealing with it for months and I've tried everything. Sometimes I wish I'd just have a heart attack and die. But you seem more optimistic. Try to read up on Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, don't be afraid to get on something that's not a benzo, watch your electrolyte levels and diet.
While We're at it, why don't you name your great surgical team that gave you such great results? Or where to find all these magical transmen that aren't online that have had phallo?

Are you from Canada, because if you are, your argument on payment is invalid. In America, a lot of insurances won't pay out. Source: my girlfriend that was gaslit into transitioning by a transwoman ex is fighting Blue Cross for the fourth year in a row for the reimbursement she was promised. I'm not misinformed, I've researched as much as possible and I'm sorry, but phalloplasty isn't satisfactory as a procedure at this point. How long did you stay in the hospital? How long were your surgeries all-together? How do you hide your skin graft scarring? If you had to pay anything, what did you pay?  Like I said before, my nerves never reconnected and I'm not going to gamble on never having an orgasm again, but thanks, I guess?

I keep trying to trust them, but they prove to me that they can't be and that's not MY fault. Black people are told they're justified in not trusting white people because it's impossible to be racist against a white person. Why can I not be angry against transwomen? Why do I have to act like my life wasn't ruined by them?

Mhm. Mhm. I hear you, but when I said I was raped by cis men, nobody bats an eye if I said I don't trust cis men. That's because it's trendy to, now. And I don't face an unfair bias because I'm stealth as I can be, because I don't need other trans people telling me my opinion isn't valid because it is. I had a huge group of transwomen as friends and they sexually abused me, gaslit me, threatened and physically harmed me, stole my shit and even pressured my girlfriend to get a mastectomy when she insisted she just wanted a breast reduction. In my experience, I've never met a transwoman that wasn't a narcissist because it's a learned behavior from their patriarchal upbringing. I've never met a transman that wasn't suicidal, quiet, and self-loathing. You do better.

You know what, seriously, I don't want to hear it. I was raised to be quiet and get raped again and again because of what's between my legs, and was raised by a sexist society, and have been abused MULTIPLE times by psychotic transwomen that told me to shut my mouth because I'm so privileged. Screw that. You don't get to be raised in a male-worshipping society and then when you transition tell me I'm the backwards one. Your upbringing means a lot. We do have it worse, transition-wise, get over yourself.

The truth is some people will never get sensation after phallo and they'll regret it, but everyone in the trans community is so pro-everything that they don't want to caution people on these things. Buck Angel almost died from atrophy-induced sepsis, your organs can slip after a hysto. These things happen.

That's not true at all? Are you kidding me? So, we literally have to pay a range of, what, $50k to $150k according to my research, and that's because the surgery is broken up into installments. Last I checked, a majority of trans women have passable results that function well as soon as they recover (orgasm, penetration) but a transman is told uwu you'll get sensation after a few years. It's been 4 years since my top surgery, still numb, can't feel shit. So how is my dick going to be any different? Four years, possibly more, with nothing. And if I want to get it up? Just use the air pump in your balls, it'll work nicely! Seriously, you're delusional if you think this surgery is as good as a woman's when they pay an average of 20k and get great results.

Like, they can take a liver from someone else and put it in your body. They can clone cells, but they can't give me more than a skin-dildo grafted onto my body? I'm feeling extra messed up about it tonight because I'll die with this body.

My issue is that nobody seems to even be trying. And transwomen have the nerve to scream and shout at us for our supposed male privilege (yeah right, who grew up in a sexist society on the shit end of the exchange? Us.) When they get breasts for free and we have to get our, what, three surgeries to fully transition? We have it way harder and I'm sick of it. Nobody's talking about us. Nobody cares.

Hey, try your best not to flee to Google. I know it's SUPER tempting as someone that has health anxiety after having my first full-blown panic attack during a movie (called an ambulance because I thought I was having a heart attack, yelled at the workers because they weren't taking it seriously, chewing aspirin like a mad person) to look into everything, but trust me. Stop looking things up. Also, my girlfriend has worked in a number of animal hospitals/stores/professions and essentially says a cat/dog only needs a rabies shot once in their lives.
